claims.text: Japanese slogan 喰うか、喰われるか
Samus ambushed, stranded on an unfamiliar moon, falls into its depths gravely injured; Metroid instincts let her absorb prey's energy and devour foes
a mysterious group hunting her believes it gains the power of those it defeats by eating them; camera behind Samus in those duels
release 28 Jan 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2; pre-orders open; all-new entry
the slogan appears in a Japanese ad shared by Genki
